The '''Temple Guardians''', also known as the '''Chamber Guardians''', were a group that guarded the [[Star Temple]]s of the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]]. They were originally entirely composed of giant [[whuffa worm]]s, but [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] became a Temple Guardian after he [[Death/Legends|killed]] one of the [[Worm/Legends|worms]].
